info.title: RoPA API
info.description:
Record of Processing Activities (GDPR Article 30).

Reads are public by default and an anonymous caller is treated as a viewer; every write needs a token. Mint one at `POST /v1/tokens`, then use **Authorize** above.

Demo project. All data is synthetic; no real personal data is used.
